verified_findings: General 2027 V2 dated November 4 now announces May 28–31 Seoul without the old tentative qualifier; dedicated World page and official cohost corroborate. Generic HTML timeline still says TENTATIVE: retained as a residual status conflict, not silently erased. Calendar stores the announced overall championship window, not a confirmed RoboParade category day or a travel booking.
US May 7–8 championship is an overall window; May 8 RoboParade times in its category table remain TENTATIVE and are not timed calendar entries.

RoboParade Explorer grades 1–4 in spring 2027, Junior 5–8; one to five students and one float. Two siblings may form one team only after actual school grades and country route are confirmed. Single-student team permitted but lowest teamwork score.

RoboParade V2 removes the V1 straight-lines-only Explorer concession. Explorer has one clockwise 10+2 minute round and no required speed display; full dimensions, bumper, autonomous stop/restart and rubric trophy distinction preserved.

Taiwan still links V1 as checked from the live home and downloaded linked PDF; global V2 does not automatically become the local edition. Do not apply global category metadata to Taiwan through a cloned template.

Member countries use International Directors and conditional quotas, including Open; non-members can seek direct Open or Game/Exhibition International Video. Mexico director is listed; no Costa Rica listing does not prove non-member eligibility. Country choice is not automatic from parental passport.

Video qualifier covers Game/Exhibition only, not Explorer. April 12 23:59 Eastern = April 13 03:59 UTC is an exact submission deadline; RMS 23:00–23:30 is not treated as a live event. Game tasks April 1, Exhibition 4-minute presentation and 2-minute Q&A.

Two actual 2027 US Game qualifiers listed in Houston and Clinton Township, with published date-only closing dates. Lutz has event March 3 but closing March 24; both operational dates left out until clarification.

Two LTU Saturday workshops have zero workshop charge only for an already paid qualifying/pre-registration team. Budget counts one USD 110 registration foundation, not one fee per child or per workshop. Pre-Registration December 31 explicitly is not a real event and never becomes a calendar competition.

Two Libya RMS archive records are season 2027 listings dated in 2026. They establish published historical records, not actual event delivery, participation, trophies or a future open intake. Country coverage becomes 86 with records, not 86 complete audits.

All ten global category families are summarized from the general category table. Only General V2 and RoboParade V2 key technical parts were deeply reviewed; do not call every category or national rulebook fully audited.
